title: On Attaching a small tag to the handle
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：attach　|　正文 370 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 attach 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the nurse ① attached a small tag to the handle for the whole place, and every sufferer in the ward said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the nurse ② attaches a small tag to the handle without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ attach a small tag to the handle at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ attached a small tag to the handle before — a line in the report for April 1981 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Attaching a small tag to the handle for the whole place, the nurse said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ attach too much weight to the matter without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Attach too much weight to the matter at once and never mention it again.

By 1994 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new sufferer from the next ward ⑧ attaches too much weight to the matter for the whole place every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cupboard, said nothing at all; she simply  attached a small tag to the handle again when nobody else would.

To attach a small tag to the handle, my mother said in 1999, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the ward remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the ward forgets, somebody attaches a small tag to the handle without a word of thanks again and somebody must attach a small tag to the handle for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 系上（一般过去式 attached a small tag to the handle：1987 年护士头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 系上（一般现在 attaches a small tag to the handle：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 系上（不定式 to attach a small tag to the handle：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 系上（过去完成时 had attached a small tag to the handle：1981 年四月的护理记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 系上（动名词 attaching a small tag to the handle 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 看重（attach too much weight to the matter：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去看重这件事上太重的分量）
G. v. 看重（attach too much weight to the matter：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 系上（后段两处：新来的病患照例 attaches too much weight to the matter，而母亲又一次 attached a small tag to the handle）

answers.why: attach 意为“系上”，1987 年护士替所有人系上把手上系一个小牌，那是病房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 attached。
attach 意为“系上”，自那以后护士不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 attaches。
attach 意为“系上”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯系上把手上系一个小牌”，此处为不定式 to attach a small tag to the handle。
attach 意为“系上”，护理记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1994 年之前就有人系上过，故用过去完成时 had attached。
attach 意为“系上”，护士说“系上把手上系一个小牌这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 attaching a small tag to the handle 作主语。
attach 意为“看重”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去看重这件事上太重的分量”，should ever 之后用原形 attach too much weight to the matter。
attach 意为“看重”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻看重这件事上太重的分量（attach too much weight to the matter at once），以后再也不要提起。
attach 意为“系上”，新来的病患每个夜晚都照例看重这件事上太重的分量，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 attaches。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 attach 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the nurse attached a small tag to the handle for the whole place, and nobody in the ward forgot it.
Even now the nurse attaches a small tag to the handle without a word of thanks whenever the ward asks.
Attaching a small tag to the handle for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever attach too much weight to the matter without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sufferer from the next ward attaches too much weight to the matter for the whole place every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother attached a small tag to the handle again, and the ward remembered that half.
